basic_details.job_title: IAF LDC Recruitment 2026 - Apply Offline for Lower Division Clerk Posts
basic_details.short_information: Indian Air Force (IAF) Lower Division Clerk (LDC) Notification 2026 has been released through Advertisement No. 03/2026 on the official website indianairforce.nic.in. A total of 1 vacancy has been announced through the IAF Lower Division Clerk (LDC) Recruitment 2026.

important_dates.last_date_to_apply: 30 days from the date of publication
important_dates.age calculated as on: Last date of receipt of application

qualification.details: Educational Qualification | 12th Class pass from a recognized Board. Typing speed of 35 words per minute (wpm) in English or 30 wpm in Hindi on computer. (35 wpm and 30 wpm correspond to 10500 KDPH / 9000 KDPH on an average of 5 key depressions for each word. Time allowed: 10 minutes). | Age Limit | 18 to 25 years as on the last date of receipt of application. | Age Relaxation (as applicable) | Ex-Servicemen: Period of service in the Armed Forces shall be deducted from actual age. If the resultant age does not exceed the prescribed maximum age by more than 3 years, the candidate shall be deemed to satisfy the age condition. SC/ST/OBC candidates applying against Unreserved (UR) posts are not entitled to any relaxation in age limit, experience, etc. Other relaxations as per Government of India rules for eligible categories. | Nationality | Only Indian citizens are eligible.

vacancy_details.Postal Address: Air Officer Commanding, Air Force Station, Tezpur, Assam – 784104

category_wise_vacancy.Postal Address: Air Officer Commanding, Air Force Station, Tezpur, Assam – 784104

selection_process: Scrutiny of Applications – All applications will be scrutinized for age limit

documents and certificates. Written Test – Shortlisted candidates will be called for the written examination. Skill Test (Typing Test) – Qualifying in nature only. Document Verification – Original certificates and copies of Annexure to be produced.

Syllabus: (i) General Intelligence (ii) English Language (iii) Numerical Aptitude (iv) General Awareness Question-cum-answer paper will be set in both English and Hindi. Marking System: Written Test – 100% weightage Skill Test – Qualifying only
The written test centre may be different from the place to which the application was sent (purely for administrative convenience).
how_to_apply: Eligible candidates must apply offline in the prescribed format (Annexure-I).
Steps to Apply:
Download / obtain the proforma application form (Annexure-I).
Fill the form carefully in English or Hindi (typed preferred).
Paste a recent self-attested passport-size photograph on the form.
Attach two additional identical passport-size photographs.

Attach self-attested copies of the following documents: Educational qualification certificates Age / Date of Birth proof Caste certificate (if applicable) Experience certificate (if any) Discharge book (for ESM candidates) PwBD certificate in prescribed format (if applicable) Domicile certificate (if required)
Educational qualification certificates
Age / Date of Birth proof
Caste certificate (if applicable)
Experience certificate (if any)
Discharge book (for ESM candidates)
PwBD certificate in prescribed format (if applicable)
Domicile certificate (if required)
Prepare a self-addressed envelope.
Write clearly on the top of the envelope: “APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF LOWER DIVISION CLERK (LDC)”
Send the completed application form along with all enclosures by post to:
Air Officer Commanding Air Force Station, Tezpur Assam – 784104
Important:
Application must reach the above address within 30 days from the date of publication of the advertisement.
Applications received after the closing date will not be entertained.
Incomplete applications or applications not in the prescribed format will be rejected.
IAF will not be responsible for any postal delay.
important_instructions: Candidates must fulfil all eligibility conditions as on the last date of receipt of application. Selected candidates will be subject to “All India Service Liability”. Merely fulfilling the basic selection criteria does not automatically entitle a person to be called for test. Candidates are to bring original certificates along with self-attested photocopies at the time of document verification. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the written test / skill test. The Air Officer Commanding, Air Force Station, Tezpur has the right to reject any application without assigning any reason. Number of vacancies / reservation status at any Air Force Station may change at any time before the selection process. Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification.

Candidates interested in similar defence sector opportunities can also explore the latest Indian Air Force Recruitment, Indian Army Recruitment, and Central Government Jobs notifications. Those seeking clerical and administrative positions may also check ongoing LDC Recruitment, Group C Jobs, and 12th Pass Government Jobs available across various Central Government departments and organizations.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in IAF LDC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 01 vacancy for the post of Lower Division Clerk (LDC) at Air Force Station Tezpur, Assam under Advertisement No. 03/2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for IAF LDC 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of offline application is 30 days from the date of publication of the advertisement.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for IAF LDC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 18 and 25 years as on the last date of receipt of application. Age relaxation is available for Ex-Servicemen and other eligible categories as per rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for IAF LDC post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed 12th Class from a recognized Board and possess a typing speed of 35 wpm in English or 30 wpm in Hindi on computer.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for IAF LDC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No application fee is required. The fee is Nil for all categories.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for IAF LDC 2026?
faq.answer: Selection involves scrutiny of applications, Written Test (100% weightage), Skill Test (Typing – Qualifying only), and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for IAF LDC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications are accepted only offline. Candidates must send the filled Annexure-I form with required documents by post to Air Officer Commanding, Air Force Station, Tezpur, Assam – 784104.
